crossRefs.note: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire…
The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found…
Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and…
How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell…
Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the…
For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow…
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his…
It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out…
The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell—and great was its fall.”

people.name: Egypt

people.name: Nile
people.line: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts

translations.web: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.
translations.bsb: The Lord GOD of Hosts, He who touches the earth and it melts, and all its dwellers mourn— all the land rises like the Nile, then sinks like the river of Egypt—
translations.kjv: And the Lord GOD of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
translations.asv: For the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, is he that toucheth the land and it melteth, and all that dwell therein shall mourn; and it shall rise up wholly like the River, and shall sink again, like the River of Egypt;
